instruction: For each rule below, declare where it is verified. Use ONLY names from `evidence`. Omit a rule entirely rather than guess - an unresolvable trace is worse than none, because it reports as covered while nothing verifies the rule. Return JSON: { "proposals": [ { "id": "BR-...", "traces": { "ui": [], "api": [], "db": [], "tests": [] } } ] }

rules.text:
- id: BR-IMP-001
    statement: Impound Dashboard renders a work queue with row-level fields for tracking impounded vehicle accounts (see table_column_contract.required_headers for the full field list).
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-002
    statement: A header record-count display ("Showing X of Y Records") reflects the currently loaded/filtered result set size.
    priority: Low

- id: BR-IMP-003
    statement: A "Show Archived Accounts" toggle controls whether archived accounts — accounts whose Impound Status is a final status (see table_column_contract Impound Status status_lifecycle) — are included in the result set; off by default, which excludes them.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-004
    statement: An "Action Needed" indicator (bell icon with a red dot) is shown in the dashboard header when one or more accounts require attention.
    priority: Medium
    note: Exact trigger criteria and click behavior are not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-005
    statement: "Loan # is styled as a hyperlink (blue text) on each row."
    priority: Medium
    note: Destination of the link is not yet confirmed (likely an account detail page, by analogy with sibling dashboards).

- id: BR-IMP-006
    statement: Impound Status is an editable per-row dropdown (single value per row) constrained to the supported status list (see table_column_contract Impound Status); the same status list is available as multi-select options in the Impound Status filter.
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-007
    statement: Impound State is an editable per-row dropdown (single value per row) constrained to the supported state/territory list (see table_column_contract Impound State), or "Select..." when unset.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-008
    statement: Claim Status is a read-only pass-through value that can be sourced from either the Insurance Dashboard's Lienholder Claim sub-module or its Total Loss sub-module (OR logic); Total Loss Status is a read-only pass-through value owned by the Total Loss sub-module. A value change made on the owning sub-module must be reflected on Impound (see data_population_rules.pass_through_fields).
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-018
    statement: Each Impound Status value is classified as final (terminal/closed) or non-final (in-progress), with a defined sort order for display grouping (see table_column_contract Impound Status status_lifecycle).
    priority: Medium
    note: Duplicate/Error and Fee Dispute are not yet classified as final or non-final.

- id: BR-IMP-009
    statement: DPD (Days Past Due) is a read-only numeric column.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-010
    statement: Last Payment Date and Follow Up Date are date columns.
    priority: Medium
    note: Editability of these columns is not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-011
    statement: Loan Number and VIN are copyable but not editable.
    priority: Medium
    note: Copyability is assumed by analogy with sibling dashboards and not yet directly confirmed for Impound.

- id: BR-IMP-012
    statement: The left-hand-side filter panel exposes Loan Number, VIN, Impound Status, Impound State, Assigned To, PTP, Follow Up Date, Impound Completed Date, Days on Impound Dashboard, Date of Impound, Lien Sale Date, Notice Received Date, and Last Worked Date (see filter_inventory).
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-013
    statement: Filter selections in the left-hand-side filter panel are only applied to the result set when Apply is clicked; Cancel discards pending selections without applying them.
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-014
    statement: PTP renders as a "Select..." dropdown in the filter panel rather than a date-range control.
    priority: Medium
    note: Allowed option values are not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-015
    statement: Days on Impound Dashboard is a numeric Min/Max range filter.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-016
    statement: Each filter in the panel has an adjacent overflow (⋮) control.
    priority: Low
    note: Exact behavior (e.g. pin, clear-single-filter, reorder) is not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-017
    statement: The right-hand-side panel provides Notes, Loan Details, Loan Documents, Financial Snapshot, Events, and Email History tabs for the selected row (see right_hand_side_contract.enabled_tabs).
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-019
    statement: An account is populated onto the Impound dashboard when a Vehicle Impounded event is added for it via Unifi, which creates a new impound instance for the account (see data_population_rules.eligibility_rules, instance_contract).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-IMP-020
    statement: If an account already has an active impound instance, a subsequent Vehicle Impounded event does not create a new/duplicate instance for that account.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-IMP-021
    statement: Each occurrence of an account being impounded is tracked as a distinct instance identified by an instance_id; an account may have multiple instances over its lifetime, but only one is active at a time (see instance_contract).
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-022
    statement: Repo Status is a read-only pass-through value reflecting the account's corresponding repossession status in Leapfrog (dev3) (see data_population_rules.pass_through_fields).
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-023
    statement: Assigned To is an editable per-row dropdown (single value per row) showing the person (e.g. agent) assigned to the account.
    priority: Medium
    note: Full allowed-value list not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-024
    statement: Days on Impound Dashboard is a read-only computed numeric column reflecting how long the account's active instance has been on the dashboard.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-025
    statement: The table column and its corresponding left-hand-side filter use different labels for the same field in two cases — "PTP Date" (column) / "PTP" (filter) and "Last Worked" (column) / "Last Worked Date" (filter) — mirroring the Client/Client Name label pattern documented on sibling dashboards.
    priority: Low

- id: BR-IMP-026
    statement: The Notes column displays a note icon together with a truncated text preview/link of the note content (e.g. "Check Insurance") when a note exists for the row.
    priority: Medium
    note: Whether Notes on Impound is private to this dashboard, by analogy with Remarketing Titles' Notes field, is not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-027
    statement: The Assigned To widget on the Details Page records each prior assignment with a timestamp when the assignment changes, and displays the resulting Assignment History list in reverse chronological order (most recent first).
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-028
    statement: When the account's LF (Leapfrog) Securement/Repo Status becomes "Secured - Impound", the system automatically populates the Secured Date on the Impound Dashboard and sets the Impound Status to "Vehicle Secured", always overwriting the current Impound Status regardless of its prior value.
    priority: Critical
    note: '"Impound Secured Date" in the source ticket maps to the existing Secured Date column (confirmed with requester); no separate column is added.'

- id: BR-IMP-029
    statement: "Impound Completed Date is populated with the current system date when the Impound Status changes to any final status (Vehicle Secured, Client Secured, Insurance Secured, Impound Cancelled, Lien loss, Not Impound)."
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-030
    statement: Once the Impound Completed Date is populated it is not overwritten by any future status update.
    priority: High

- id: BR-IMP-032
    statement: When Days on Impound Dashboard is greater than 5, its value is displayed in red on the dashboard list view.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-033
    statement: The Days on Impound Dashboard column is positioned immediately before the Date of Impound column on the main dashboard list view (already reflected in table_column_contract.required_headers ordering).
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-034
    statement: Exporting Impound Dashboard data produces a file that includes all dashboard columns, including the new/updated fields.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-IMP-035
    statement: The Basic Details widget on the Details Page includes a "Titles Details Page" link that navigates to the corresponding account's Details Page on the Titles module.
    priority: Medium
    note: Destination sub-module/tab and whether it opens in the same browser tab or a new one are not yet confirmed.

- id: BR-IMP-036
    statement: A Notes section on the Details Page, positioned directly below the Email widget, provides a free-text field for internal reference (see account_detail_page_contract.sections Notes); distinct from the right-hand-side panel's Notes tab (see specs/components/account-details-page.component.yaml left_hand_side_contract.notes_section_contract).
    priority: Medium
    note: Exact save behavior (own Save control vs. page-bottom Save button) not yet confirmed for Impound specifically.

- id: BR-IMP-037
    statement: When an account has no Notice Received Date, Days on Impound Dashboard renders blank ("-") rather than a numeric value, since the calculation has no baseline to measure from (see BR-IMP-031).
    priority: High
    note: 'Per SERV-12124: confirmed with requester that a missing baseline shows no value rather than falling back to Date of Impound or defaulting to 0.'
